text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the break, Aston Machan is peering
intently into my face for some reason...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm checking to see if Trainer-san
forgot about Chan during the break."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Can you see Chan-Me
clearly through your lens, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad. Starting today, please don't take
your eyes off Chan-me as she does her best again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Aston Machan says with an energetic look. It seems she was able to get some good rest.
